title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: C_R missing from TH_2 computation (RFC 9528 Section 4.1)
description: RFC 9528 Section 4.1 requires TH_2 = H(CBOR(G_Y), CBOR(C_R), CBOR(H(message_1))) for EDHOC Method 3 (and all methods where responder sends message_2). Both Python (edhoc.py lines 389, 598) and Rust (edhoc.rs lines 415, 782, 1137) compute TH_2 as H(CBOR(G_Y), CBOR(H(message_1))) — omitting C_R entirely. The `transcript_2()` function signature only takes `g_y` and `msg1`, not `c_r`. This weakens transcript hash binding by not including the responder's connection identifier. Same bug exists in both EdhocInitiator.process_message_2() and EdhocResponder.process_message_1().
